items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: There was one guy that came over to me once and said, “we’d like to welcome you to the band.” Harry Carney.

ctx.x: Were the veterans in that band, did you have to like prove yourself to them, in their attitude towards you? You were always the newcomer?

Well to some degree. But I was kind of cocky. I knew what I was doing. And what they had to say didn’t matter. There was one guy that came over to me once and said, “we’d like to welcome you to the band.” Harry Carney. Shook my hand. He says, “enjoy and good luck.” And there was one guy one night that said something to me about — something about the rhythm. I says, “well look, I can play your part better than you can. And it’s a different instrument. So just go ahead and play your part if you can.” That was the…
